name: Prayerfulness
overview: Scripture reveals prayerfulness as a heartfelt and continual communication with God, exemplified by David’s earnest morning prayers and his commitment to direct his voice to the Lord (Psalms 5:1-3). Prayer is portrayed as both a refuge and a vital expression of love toward God, even amid adversity, as the psalmist gives himself wholly to prayer despite opposition (Psalms 109:4). The believer’s confidence in God’s attentive ear encourages persistent calling upon Him throughout life, reflecting a deep reliance on God’s lovingkindness both day and night (Psalms 42:8; 116:2).
